intro.vo: How to make a sale. Five simple steps.

beats.caption: Hatua 1: Fungua Sehemu ya Mauzo
beats.vo: Step one. Tap the sales tab to open the point of sale.

beats.caption: Hatua 2: Gusa bidhaa ili kuziongeza kwenye kikapu
beats.vo: Step two. Tap a product to add it to the cart. Tap again to add more.

beats.caption: Hatua 3: Hakiki kikapu na ubadilishe idadi
beats.vo: Step three. Check your cart, and change the quantities with the plus and minus buttons.

beats.caption: Hatua 4: Chagua njia ya malipo na ukamilishe mauzo
beats.vo: Step four. Choose how the customer pays, enter the amount, and complete the sale.

beats.caption: Hatua 5: Tazama risiti, kisha uchapishe au ushiriki
beats.vo: Step five. View the receipt, then print it or share it with your customer.

endCard.title: Sasampa POS
endCard.subtitle: Tazama mafunzo mengine.
endCard.vo: That is all. Watch our other tutorials to learn more.
